description: This Java class is a builder for creating instances of ImmutableJsonFieldSelector, providing methods to add, remove, and manage JSON pointers and field definitions for JSON field selection.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorBuilder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing ImmutableJsonFieldSelector instances, managing JSON pointers and field selector strings.

classes.name: JsonPointerIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for iterating over the set of JSON pointers within the builder.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorBuilder.

methods.name: addPointerString
methods.description: Adds a JSON pointer from a string or CharSequence to the builder.

methods.name: addPointerStrings
methods.description: Adds multiple JSON pointers from an iterable of strings.

methods.name: addPointer
methods.description: Adds a JSONPointer object and further pointers to the builder.

methods.name: addFieldDefinition
methods.description: Adds a field definition's pointer to the builder.

methods.name: addFieldSelector
methods.description: Adds a field selector to the builder.

methods.name: addFieldSelectorString
methods.description: Adds a field selector from a string with options.

methods.name: addFieldSelectorString
methods.description: Adds a field selector from a string with default parse options.

methods.name: removePointerString
methods.description: Removes a pointer specified by a string.

methods.name: removePointerStrings
methods.description: Removes multiple pointers specified by strings.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an ImmutableJsonFieldSelector instance.
